name: GITS
plain: Looks up a precomputed schedule by coeff (15 values, 0.80 to 1.50 in 0.05 steps) and step count (19 rows per coeff, for 2 to 20 steps). Above 20 steps it log-linearly stretches the 20-step row. Header comment cites zju-pi/diff-sampler gits-main. All rows span the SD1-style 14.6146 to 0.0292 range.
math:
If steps ≤ 20: σ = T[coeff][steps−2].
Else: σ = loglinear_interp(T[coeff][−1], steps+1).
Keep last round(steps·denoise)+1 values; last forced to 0.
label: from code
surprise: The tables are not resampled below 20 steps, so each row is its own schedule, and rows share long common tails of table sigmas (nodes_gits.py:363).
